column1: # The code checks of lesson P/02: rows of the
# kinds of the closed dictionary Platform/common/acceptance/forms/code-rules.tsv, which defines the columns, the outcome and the checks; no expected
# answer. name: the name that the profile field code (of the profile of 02-installer) maps to a symbol of the candidate; the names are not code paths.
# stage: the stage of forms/stages.tsv from which the row holds, under the gate code:* of that stage and of every later stage that holds code:*. norm:
# the norms of the subject. Cores: manifest_load (the loader by text, form and relations), canonical (the projection), rights_core (the derivation of
# rights), order_core (the installation order), rollout_core (the voter poll); the machine of the poll in the form Step(State, Event) -> (State,
# []Effect) is rollout_step. The pinned libraries of the loader are requires_module rows of stage manifest-load; as packages of pinned modules they are
# leaves of the walk of its pure_core row. The seams s1–s4 of acceptance/1/seams.tsv judge the loading by its behavior.
